\section[el empleo]{el empleo — the job, employment}

\label{lesson:ES-C490-empleo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Spanish for the town hall, then the Spanish for the postbox.

\subsection*{You'll want to know: el empleo}
\textbf{el empleo} — \textquotedblleft{}the job, employment\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Busco empleo como cocinero.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{I am looking for a job as a cook.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Oficina de empleo} — job centre.
